title: 〜っぽい
simpleExplanation: 〜っぽい turns a word into an い-adjective meaning "has the quality of / looks like / tends to": 子供っぽい = childish, 忘れっぽい = forgetful, 白っぽい = whitish. The feeling is often slightly negative or casual: the thing is not really X, it just seems X.
whenUsed: Casual speech and writing. Conjugates like an い-adjective (っぽく, っぽかった). Common words: 怒りっぽい, 飽きっぽい, 安っぽい, 水っぽい, 男っぽい, 女っぽい.
formation: Noun + っぽい (子供っぽい, 油っぽい)
Verb (ます stem) + っぽい (忘れっぽい, 怒りっぽい)
い-adjective stem + っぽい (安っぽい, 白っぽい)

examples.ja: 彼は最近、忘れっぽくなった。
examples.reading: かれはさいきん、わすれっぽくなった。
examples.note: V-ます + っぽい: forgetful (a tendency).

examples.ja: 子供っぽい服は着たくない。
examples.reading: こどもっぽいふくはきたくない。
examples.en: I don't want to wear childish clothes.

examples.ja: この写真、少し白っぽいね。
examples.reading: このしゃしん、すこししろっぽいね。
examples.en: This photo looks a bit whitish.
examples.note: い-adjective stem + っぽい: whitish (color tint).

examples.ja: 彼は怒りっぽいから、言葉に気をつけたほうがいい。
examples.reading: かれはおこりっぽいから、ことばにきをつけたほうがいい。
examples.en: He's quick-tempered, so you'd better watch your words.
examples.note: 怒りっぽい: tends to get angry.

examples.ja: このバッグ、デザインはいいけど、ちょっと安っぽいね。
examples.reading: このバッグ、デザインはいいけど、ちょっとやすっぽいね。
examples.en: This bag has a nice design, but it looks a bit cheap.
examples.note: 安っぽい: looks cheap (not necessarily cheap).

similarGrammar.difference: Typical of, in a good way: 男らしい (manly). っぽい can be critical.
Tends to (actions, undesirable): 遅刻しがち. っぽい is about qualities and appearance.

commonMistakes.why: らしい is positive ("a proper child"); for a criticism use っぽい.
Verbs attach with the ます stem.
い-adjectives drop い before っぽい.

usageNotes: 子供っぽい (childish, negative) vs 子供らしい (childlike, appropriate). Common: 怒りっぽい, 飽きっぽい, 安っぽい, 水っぽい, 男っぽい.
In slang, っぽい after a clause means "seems like": 雨っぽい, 行くっぽい (very casual).
jlptTips: A description with a hint of criticism (acting like, looking cheap, tending to) = っぽい.
The らしい / っぽい contrast is a common item: positive typicality = らしい, negative imitation = っぽい.
Check the stem: ます stem for verbs, adjective stem without い.
